subject: Cross-portal evidence orchestration and role mapping for Vendr / OneTrust
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@vendr.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Whistic Integrations <integrations@whistic.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendr & OneTrust onboarding — initial evidence handoff

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for taking this on — excited to get Redwood's security profile into Vendr and sync it with OneTrust. To speed things up, I attached a short evidence mapping template (evidence-mapping-template.xlsx) that maps common SIG/CAIQ controls to typical artifacts we ingest.

Couple of quick questions we need to resolve before bulk upload:
- Do you have a canonical owner list (title + email) we should map into role access on the portal?
- Will you be providing evidence via S3 bucket upload or do you prefer our API (we can accept multipart upload)?
- Any SOC 2-specific artifacts that need special handling (e.g., encrypted backups, redaction)?

If easier, I can spin up a shared staging folder on Vendr and drop the initial set. I copied Whistic integrations so they can call out any portal mapping quirks.

Best,
Elena
Customer Success Manager | Vendr

Attachment: evidence-mapping-template.xlsx (spreadsheet, 34KB)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@vendr.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Apr 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendr & OneTrust onboarding — initial evidence handoff

Elena — thanks for the template, looks good. Quick answers and next steps from our side: 

- Owner list: attaching a CSV (redwood-portal-roles.csv) with the proposed role mappings (Security Owner, App Owner, Legal). Can you confirm Vendr role names so we map cleanly?
- Upload method: we prefer an S3 staging bucket ( Redacted: s3://redwood-evidence-staging ) for bulk artifacts; please confirm Vendr has an IAM role we can grant for limited put/list. For incremental/api-driven evidence, we can open an API key for a service account.
- SOC 2 specifics: Mina (cc'd) will flag any artifacts that need redaction or internal-only tags; we'll provide sanitized versions where required.

Action items: 
1) Elena: confirm IAM role ARN or confirm API key flow.
2) Mina / Security: produce a redaction checklist and indicate any artifacts requiring limited visibility.
3) Aditya / Platform: prepare a short retention cadence for portal copies (30/90/365 days).

Happy to hop on a 30-min call if helpful.

—Vivek
Head of Platform Partnerships | Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-portal-roles.csv (CSV, 2KB)

From: Elena Morales <elena@vendr.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Whistic Integrations <integrations@whistic.com>, Tara Singh <tara@onetrust.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Apr 2028 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendr & OneTrust onboarding — initial evidence handoff

Thanks Vivek — confirm Vendr can accept S3 uploads. Below are the options we support: 

1) IAM role-based ingest: Provide us with an IAM role ARN that has PutObject/ListObject limited to the staging prefix. We will schedule an ingestion job and provide a manifest response.
2) API upload: we can accept signed POSTs for smaller artifacts.

Portal role names: 
- portal_admin
- evidence_manager
- view_only

I've attached our quickstart for uploads (vendr-upload-instructions.pdf). For OneTrust sync, Tara's team will do a nightly pull if we mark artifacts with the metadata key: onetrust_sync=true.

Quick note on artifacts: Vendr will preserve file-level metadata but strips certain PII by default; any legal/external-only docs should be flagged.

Elena

Attachment: vendr-upload-instructions.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@vendr.com>, Tara Singh <tara@onetrust.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Apr 2028 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendr & OneTrust onboarding — initial evidence handoff

Thanks — summary and proposed timeline: 

Onboarding plan (high level):
- Apr 24: Redwood to create staging S3 prefix and share IAM role ARN with Vendr (Vivek to action).
- Apr 26: Mina to deliver redaction checklist and initial sanitized SOC 2 artifacts (Mina to action).
- Apr 28: Vendr to run initial ingest and provide manifest + one-time sample mapping to OneTrust (Elena/Tara to action).

Role mapping mapping: we will map our internal titles to Vendr names as follows:
- Security Owner -> portal_admin
- Compliance Engineer -> evidence_manager
- Legal Reviewer -> view_only

Open items:
- Need confirmation of the IAM role ARN (Elena)
- Agree on retention windows: proposed 90 days for staging, 365 days in portal (Aditya, confirm)
- Document a fallback: if S3 ingest fails, use API upload for critical artifacts.

Elena/Tara — can you confirm the staging manifest format (fields you need) and whether Whistic will need any additional control IDs for CAIQ mapping? If not, we’ll proceed with the timeline above.

Thanks all — I’ll create a short Jira (SUP-1234) and attach the CSV/template so we have a single place to track evidence handoffs.

—Vivek
Head of Platform Partnerships | Redwood Inference
